etag.description: With code record_changed: the record's current etag.

location.description: For configuration errors: where in monitors.conf the problem is.

retry_after_s.description: With code rate_limited: seconds to wait (also sent as the Retry-After header).

bearerToken.description: API token created under /api/v1/tokens. The token's scopes decide what it may call; see x-token-scope on each operation.

sessionCookie.description: Session cookie set by POST /api/v1/session. Non-GET requests must also send the session's CSRF token in the X-Unagikuma-CSRF header.
sessionCookie.name: unagikuma_session

info.description: The REST API of the Unagikuma monitoring server. Authenticate with the session cookie (unagikuma_session, from POST /api/v1/session) or an API token sent as a Bearer token. Tokens carry scopes: read, ack, write, admin (write implies ack implies read); each operation lists the scope it needs in x-token-scope. Session-authenticated writes must send the session's CSRF token in the X-Unagikuma-CSRF header. Every failure uses the same JSON error body (see the Error schema); error codes are stable strings.
info.title: Unagikuma API
